title: Nigeria Economic Intelligence
summary: A reproducible analysis of Nigeria’s economy and labour market from 1991 to 2025: 898 observations across 25 indicators, national and for all 36 states plus the FCT.
problem: Economic figures for Nigeria are scattered across sources. This brings them together in one reproducible place.
features: Growth, prices, work and population in one dataset
Stored in PostgreSQL, reproducible in Docker
why: Economic figures for Nigeria are scattered across sources. I brought them together through validated, tracked imports with a full revision history, so the evidence for policy can be checked and rerun.
hard: Every load is checked and recorded with a revision history.
All 36 states plus the FCT, side by side.
GDP per capita is still 8.4% below its 2015 peak.
